notes.title: Mr.Hack Jack 1.3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613649/3930ca4965eeac11e76011c1666f5b7cc51a51f4.gif[/img]

Thank you all who made videos! It allowed us to find and squish more bugs.
[i][b]We're thinking about new content, what situations would you like to investigate?[/b][/i]

[b]1.3[/b] is a minor update but we're giving a round-ish number as it signifies that we (think) fixed all the major outstanding bugs.

[b]CHANGE LOG[/b]
[list]
[*] In the tutorial section, removed a UI panel that was floating outside of the world's bounds and was still visible.
[*] Fixed some material issues on the good ol' police chief.
[/list]

notes.title: Mr.Hack Jack: 1.2p5 is live!
notes.content:
Good day inspector!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613649/dd49f040e8a7d5e45e75e1d5a7216f14a7dff053.png[/img]

[i][b]If you are enjoying Mr.Hack Jack, please consider leaving a review, that helps us a lot![/b][/i]

We did some new fixes and improvements to Mr.Hack Jack: Robot Detective! Thank you to everyone who played the game and reported issues!
Don't forget, you can have a chat with us on Twitch every weekeday or discord.

- Discord: https://discord.gg/dTXJE6k
- Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/donutsvr

[b]Change log:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the controls on Vive (and maybe on WMR, please give us feedback <3)
[*] The stage sphere machine in the office has a snapping lever now
[*] Fixed some levers in the Foundry not being highlighted when hovered
[*] Fixed a memory puzzle from the Alley stage being reused in the Foundry stage
[*] Fixed a robot's message content in the Foundry being incorrect in regards to which events are triggered
[*] Fixed a missing localization field
[*] Fixed the Holo Magnifier not being highlighted when hovered
[*] Changed the color of blinkin dPad cards to make them visible
[*] Fix the mission level selection machine displaying the new mission message after completing all stages
[*] Fixed a bug in the foundry where a police bot would not move automatically after setting a fuse in a surveillance camera
[*] Changed the way robot holograms are displayed to hopefully fix a bug that would prevent the holograms to display correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2p4 is online! Happy weekend detective!
notes.content:
Hello detectives!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613649/53601e4bd87f4cb7b18ea25a81528c62d1d81e32.png[/img]

We updated Mr.Hack Jack with a host of small fixes. Thank you for reporting the issues!
If you are enjoying Mr.Hack Jack, please consider leaving a review, that helps us a lot!

change log:
[list]
[*] Clue description can't be seen through floors/ceilings now
[*] The stage sphere machine in the office has a snapping lever now
[*] Fixed an audio issue with the dancer deactivation lever in the Bar
[*] Improved the physics of the credits drawer in the detective office
[*] Improved the visuals of the police bot accessories
[*] The police bot hats should snap better to their metal head now
[*] The mission spheres will take less time to fly back to you
[*] Fixed a lighting-related error message in the Mansion stage
[*] Added more car engine plugs throughout the Alley stage
[*] Fixed the lever invisible clue displays not moving with the lever itself
[*] Removed the invisible clue indicator on the key in the Mansion stage
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2p1 available
notes.content:
Hi! 
We uploaded a patch that fixes some small issues that we found watching streamers play the game. The game will update automagically (thx steam <3)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613649/3930ca4965eeac11e76011c1666f5b7cc51a51f4.gif[/img]

[b]If you enjoy Mr.Hack Jack, please consider leaving a review, that helps a lot![/b]

[i]Patch notes:[/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with localization not appearing correctly
[*] Fixed some sounds not reacting to the sound effect mixer volume
[*] Changed the positioning of a task-giver robot to avoid some items being sucked it by the evidence gathering vortex automatically
[*] optimized some spaghetti code
[*] Fixed the physics collider on the Manneken Pis statue in stage 3
[*] Minor fixes in stage 4
[/list]

We are still investigating a crash report and will update as soon as we can fix it.

notes.title: Release date update：mid-May 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613649/a36737661d660bf94a1353eb406abeed77f679e4.png[/img]

Hello! 
Our current plan is to release Mr.Hack Jack around mid-May.

We planned for the mid-April at first, but decided to add an extra level of polish.

We're doing our best to finish the game as fast and as good as possible so stay tuned!

notes.title: ”D-pad” is Coming!!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34613649/dd1ee37dd43fb8bfcb2d990a69130e0b00efde00.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]D - pad[/b][/h1]

In our futuristic and cheerful universe, the "D-Pad" is a tool that will help you to collect and analyze every crime scene informations.


Equipped on your left arm, you, the detective, will use the "D-Pad" to crack the case and expose the truth about these mysterious incidents!


This futuristic detective tool is one of the several fun interactions we provide to our robotic detective players,

We really hope you will enjoy this feature!




この世界の探偵ツールの１つ。
情報解析・収集を行うことができる近未来ツール。

探偵のあなたは、”D-pad”を左手に装備し、
事件の糸口を発見・収集する。
このツールは、あなたを事件解決を助けてくれるだろう。


細かいところにギミックが仕込んでおり、
この近未来デザインのツールを操作することが、
このゲームの楽しみの１つになると思います。

早く多くの人に、このゲームを楽しんでいただきたいです。
